Only ZT/ZM remap when selected; Native REAL(buffer,core_rknd) happens before existing permanent remap call, iv1 and all gr/density/pressure/method arguments retain order. Time record/bounds core casts and step-window integer arithmetic retained. Surface versus profile slabs, total/batch offsets and checked write status match.
manual_review.grid: Native grid_init body performs no validation despite its stale Native description; draft accurately ports actual allocation/spread/metadata behavior. Grid refresh guards, nzt=nzm-1 consistency, shape-dependent reallocations and host/device copies match Native ownership and arithmetic.
manual_review.SILHS: Initialization gates/mismatch diagnostics and coordinate reuse/redefine order match. Native names have identical prefix/ADJUSTL/TRIM/64width truncation. Lognormal/uniform shape guards and next-record indexing match; uniform fields then core-real mixture indices then weights written in exact order; each reached write failure propagates fatal error. Present empty name lists remain distinct from absent inputs.
manual_review.date: Existing calendar owner receives same arguments. Fixed35-character template, integer I4.4/I2.2 fields, floor hour, NINT/MOD/integer minute and rounded seconds expressions match Native including overflow stars and lack of normalization.

manual_review.registry_expansion: All50template selectors and every generated suffix/prefix pair manually read. Hydro first-two-character and second-species LEN_TRIM bounds, nested j/j2 order, scalar counts and8category counts retained. Max(1,ndefs+4096), dedup before capacity rejection, first wins, name64truncation, copied template metadata plus varid/nz reset and final max(1,k)compact array match. Context-owned warning and optional-dimension rejection are explicit approved ownership/undefined-boundary adaptations.
manual_review.registry_parser: Four256-character fields, full field count even beyond capacity, pipe positions and blank-only TRIM/ADJUSTL preserve tabs/leading-comment semantics. NAME64,GRID16,UNITS32,DESC128 truncation; legacy3field path; grid aliases/unknown->ZT default; default/reset fields match.
manual_review.C_boundary: Raw ncid remains unchanged; Native variable/dimension IDs andGLOBAL0 translate once by minus1, dimension lists and hyperslab starts/counts reverse once, starts subtract1. Text attrs use exact caller length, float/double/int attrs preserve xtype and value. Doublefill pointer has queried storage contract. Typed puts enforce packed source capacity and overflow checks without precision conversions; explicit counts support all unlimited/slab writes. Fixed default-write inference and unlimited rejection are documented API limits and every stats caller supplies source-shaped counts.

Call-local intrinsic/packed-array adapters and public template memory boundaries have explicit language reasons; no Native forwarding, new global registry, new model scratch or hidden diagnostic list. Native source-range chunks preserve definition order on Root assembly. Concurrent host NetCDF access is not newly supported; sequential host-call stream is the documented current standalone scope.
